top_signals.title: Australia’s Home Loans Fall by Record After Rapid RBA Rate Hikes
top_signals.summary: Australian home loans posted a record drop in the third quarter, underscoring the erosion of borrowing demand in response to the Reserve Bank’s aggressive interest-rate increases to control inflation.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.
